summary: Flathead NF 30-foot pole L-4 tower built 1934 half a mile above US 2; destroyed in 1974 per the register's description and two other sources; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower, about half a mile above U.S. Highway 2

access.note: Register says the site is accessible via the 2-mile Garry Lookout Trail #499 from US 2; no closure or permit requirement appears in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Staffing and fire history: none found in one search and the pages read. A search summary mentioned a 1934 claim near Garry above Nyack citing npshistory.com Trails of the Past ch. 9, but the cached chapter has no Garry match, so it is unused; the Trails of the Past PDF at foresthistory.org is the next place to check. The Glacier archive photo (HPF 2605, dated 1971-02-28, David S. Shea) is the same image already on the record, so no new photo entry. Elevation 4,499 ft (register) vs 4500' (firelookout.com) is immaterial.
